Read a preprocessed single-cell fragment matrix

Source: R/setup.R
readInputTable.Rd

Reads the count matrix written by process_fragment_file.py: cells in rows, genomic bins in columns, with the first column holding the barcode.

Usage

readInputTable(inputFile, sep = "\t")

Arguments

inputFile

Path to the count matrix.

sep

Field separator. Default tab.

Value

A data frame of counts with barcodes as row names.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
scData <- readInputTable("my_sample_matrix.tsv")
} # }
